questions.q: Which document requests a detailed solution proposal from shortlisted vendors?
questions.explain: An RFP focuses on the proposed approach; an RFI gathers general information; an RFQ focuses on price.

questions.q: Which agreement sets the general terms applicable to all engagements with the same vendor?
questions.explain: The MSA is the master framework agreement. The SOW describes a specific engagement; the SLA measures service; the NDA protects information.

questions.q: Match each agreement to its purpose.

pairs.right: Describe an engagement and its deliverables

questions.explain: Each agreement answers a distinct question: performance, confidentiality, intent, and engagement scope.

questions.q: Which mechanisms allow monitoring a vendor after signing? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: An EOI is an upstream survey before selection. The other three are ongoing monitoring mechanisms.

questions.q: A vendor hosts your data in a jurisdiction where law permits seizure without notification. Which constraint is in play?
questions.explain: Location and applicable law determine legal risks and data sovereignty.

questions.q: Which document legally bounds a penetration test performed by a third party?
questions.explain: Rules of engagement define scope, authorized techniques, schedules, and the stop procedure.
